holdout_disclosure: Published fixture manifest and historical calibration metadata were visible; the candidate was fixed before opening held-out NPZ arrays. This is an engineering holdout, not a previously unseen capture or blinded clinical trial.

dose_matching.calibration: Deterministic spatially uniform labeled 18% post-motion excess decaying with tau=10 frames, physical level 1. This is an analytic synthetic cause, never inferred from capture labels.
dose_matching.target: Minimum attainable full-strength energy dose of frozen baseline and provisional diagnostic on the calibration, then binary-search each strength within [0,1]. Final deployed abstainer has zero dose and is excluded from nonzero-dose improvement claims.
dose_matching.report: Residual matching error after FP16 gain storage, false-positive dose on independent nulls, local error variance, and genuine light-step response loss using the same strengths.
dose_matching.same_realized_null_dose_identity: For nonnegative X and g<=1, relative global energy drift equals -sum(X*(1-g))/sum(X); at matched realized null dose global bias cannot improve.

evaluation.masks: Immutable original fixed_mask arrays for capture evaluation; synthetic truth/support masks fixed before candidate calls. Candidate eligibility never becomes a metric denominator.
evaluation.chronology: Original increasing frame ids, no looping, no artificial filling of gaps. Temporal deltas only between adjacent original frames. Native calibration has seven sparse snapshots, not a native temporal replay.
evaluation.signal_domain: Native physical luminance of diffuse+specular, shared scalar gain, original alpha preserved. Combined fixtures only separately labeled calibration/conditional stress; no composite-to-lobe transfer claim.
evaluation.flicker: Only CPU input/gain-field proxies. Fresh RR and final-game flicker remain unmeasured.
evaluation.acceptance: No nonidentity production correction without an independent cause observable. Lower false-positive dose bought by discarding true-excess dose is reported as a trade-off, never lighting discrimination.
